versions.changelog:
Initial release of Password Manager Migrator.

- Builds a detailed migration plan for moving between password managers (Bitwarden, 1Password, KeePass, Apple, Chrome, Proton), merging vaults, or auditing a migration.
- Generates export/import route matrix, checklists, field-mapping worksheets, and a post-migration audit process.
- Produces a TOTP re-enrollment inventory and flags attachments and other common migration traps.
- Audits results using pre/post item counts, highlights duplicates, weak, and reused entries—no real secrets are ever handled.
- Works offline with Python 3 standard library only; no network, no secret data required.
